name: Frozen rule/CNN ablation; PC only

retention_gate.meaning: Predeclared practical criterion for default use, not a training target

test_policy: No training; no CNN cutoff tuning; all three main methods use identical observed samples/config. Strong rules and narrow existing edge rules are separate. Truth never enters encoders or rule inputs. Novel means held-out structured injection mechanism, not a claim that every resulting pattern is absent from all past training. Synthetic only; real board captures remain a separate requirement.
